longForm.overview:
👨‍⚖️ is the emoji of verdict-coded 'justice served' reveal — a man judge with wig and gavel, the iconography of law, verdict-coded energy, and the universal 'court is in session' tag. Where 👨‍⚖️ reads as judge-coded male-justice and 👩‍⚖️ reads as judge-coded female-justice, 👨‍⚖️ captures the moment when the sender wants to communicate verdict-coded flex — a 'rule together 👨‍⚖️' partner moment or a 'justice served 👨‍⚖️' gavel-coded reveal. The man judge cue borrows from the universal law-enforcement tradition and the modern verdict-coded aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as verdict-coded rather than literal profession.

In real-world usage 👨‍⚖️ lives in the spaces where the sender wants to communicate gavel-coded energy. A partner sends it on a 'rule together 👨‍⚖️' check-in. A friend sends it on a 'justice served 👨‍⚖️' reveal. A coworker sends it on a 'court today 👨‍⚖️' coded message. The man judge cue is what makes the emoji feel verdict-coded — it is not just 'judge,' it is 'judge-coded law moment.'

What separates 👨‍⚖️ from the rest of the person-role family is the gavel-coded register. The emoji is not saying 'woman judge' (👩‍⚖️), 'man detective' (🕵️‍♂️), or 'man police' (👮‍♂️). It is saying 'verdict-coded justice served,' which carries a specific law-enforcement tradition. That is why 👨‍⚖️ travels especially well on partner 'rule together' check-ins, verdict reveals, and any context where the sender wants the message to land with gavel-coded energy.
